title: Playing Caracas television with a local band
summary: Armstrong describes a TV show in Caracas with two bands, an opera overture in jazz, and his theme song.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: While you were down in Caracas, did you by any chance happen to get in personal contact with, uh, uh, some of our band leaders and musicians? I played on the TV there. Yeah.

Played a whole album. With your, your big leader there, what's it. And they played a whole opera overture with jazz and everything in it. Well, even with Nobody Knows, Go Round Moses, and then to my theme song, right into us. I got that on tape. One of the grandest TV films I've ever played with a live audience. But that's all we had, just the two bands.
